text_block_list.text: (Clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much, everyone!! This was 
Falco!

Having finished 1st in her debut race, 
Smart Falcon brilliantly claimed the 
center position in the Winning Live.
choice_data_list: That was a wonderful live show!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I feel so floaty. It's like... I still 
can't believe it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was happy to sing in front of everyone. 
Basking in the spotlight felt so good.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Still—that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"All the penlights everyone was waving, 
too, belonged entirely to Falco."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's cheers, their gazes... they 
reached straight to me at center stage."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible. Winning Lives are... 
truly something else.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Being center is... so much fun!!
choice_data_list: A bigger stage will be even more fun.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I had so much fun on my 
debut stage, after all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand on an even bigger stage! I 
want to become a top Umadol!!

Experiencing center stage for the first 
time seems to have strengthened her desire 
to reach the top even further.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

"Smart Falcon, who had made the best 
possible start, was bursting with 
motivation even during our strategy 
meeting—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Pop quiz! What is the very first thing a 
rookie Umadol fresh off her debut should 
do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Bzzzzt! Well, okay, maybe not totally 
wrong, but still!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The correct umadol answer is, "Total 
grassroots hustle! Win over fans at live 
shows!"☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in lots of races and stand 
in the center stage so many times!
choice_data_list: Then let's keep taking 1st place in races.

text_block_list.text:
Since she won her debut race, the range of 
races she can enter has expanded.

If she keeps taking 1st place in those, 
naturally, the spotlight on her will 
continue to grow.
choice_data_list:
Win at least two races, and popularity 
will follow.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okey-doke☆ As long as I win, right?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure everyone remembers the 
rookie Umadol, Falco~♪

And so, the Junior Class goal was set to 
raise her profile by winning at least two 
Pre-OP or higher races.
